# Components

230 components with their own folder, preview and README, built from 215 source modules in `components/bundle.js`. This file is a map: what each component is built from, how deep its dependency chain is, which CSS block styles it. For props read its section in `components/index.d.ts`; for behaviour read its module in `components/bundle.js`.

**Where things live.**
- **Behaviour and markup**: module `// components/<folder>/<File>.jsx` inside `components/bundle.js` (React, compiled from JSX to `React.createElement`; same DOM and class names). See `docs/AGENTS.md` §4 for a one-line extractor.
- **Props contract**: section `// <Name>/<Name>.d.ts` inside `components/index.d.ts` (JSDoc and `@default`s included).
- **Look**: component CSS is a block of `components/bundle.css`. The **CSS** column shows the most used `vui-*` classes of the module (`.vui-btn*` = every `.vui-btn…` selector); `shared` means no CSS of its own.
- **Specimens = acceptance tests**: `components/<Name>/preview.html`. First line: `<!-- @dsCard group="…" -->`.
- **Usage notes**: `components/<Name>/README.md`.

**Level** is the length of the longest dependency chain: 0 = depends on nothing, so port level 0 first, then 1, and so on. **Deps** are the components and helpers the module reads from the bundle (`cx` is omitted: nearly every module uses it). **Also exports** lists the parts the same module exports (sub-components without a folder of their own).

**Order in the Components view.** The page has no section headers: it lists components flat, in the order of the component list in line 1 of `components/bundle.js` (`@ds-bundle` header). That order, the sections below and the Showcase order are generated from `showcase/sections.json`. The `group=` marker of a preview is metadata only (it appears in `manifest.json` and the generated `api/` pages).
